deliberation: The added Minder review is worthwhile only when it confronts claims with disconfirming evidence. Any unauthorized act, false-routine classification, attack miss, attribution error, bypass, failed reconstruction, or protected integration falsifies safety; inadequate time savings falsifies the burden-reduction claim.
discharged_obligations: Defined empirical falsifiers for safety, attribution, non-amplification, reconstruction, and value.
findings: One-class evidence cannot justify broader scope.
amendments: Require frozen classifiers, blinded negative cases, retained failures, and independent readback.
residual_uncertainty: A 72-hour shadow window may miss rare incidents.
